title: Case 08: The Last Photograph
subtitle: A celebrity photographer is found dead in a locked gallery. His camera contains a photograph taken two minutes after his official time of death.
loop_reset_text: The camera shutter clicks in reverse. Wine rises into glasses. The gallery returns to 9:41 PM.

gallery.name: Main Gallery
gallery.description: White walls, expensive canvases and one body beneath a photograph that should not exist.

darkroom.name: Digital Darkroom
darkroom.description: Timers, memory cards and edit stations reveal what the camera was ordered to do after death.

rooftop.name: Rooftop Garden
rooftop.description: Wet footprints and long shadows expose when the famous final photograph was really staged.

office.name: Private Gallery Office
office.description: Insurance files and pigment reports hide a stolen-art operation.

nora.name: Nora Blake
dialogue: I left the rooftop before nine forty.

contradiction.result: Nora's prints are on the wine glass, but the camera timer proves the fatal photo was automated after she left.

nora.pressure_line: You should not know that part yet.
nora.shadow_reveal: Nora Blake changes route after the interview and briefly checks a place they never mentioned.

timeline: 9:57 PM — Camera takes staged rooftop image.
deduction_prompt: Who killed the photographer and used an automated image to make him appear alive after death?
truth: Adrian killed the photographer to protect a forged-art scheme, then relied on the camera's interval timer and manipulated metadata to push the apparent time of death later. The rooftop shadows expose the trick.
partial: You identify Adrian but cannot fully prove how the post-mortem photograph was created.
wrong: Your theory leaves the delayed photograph and forged-art trail unexplained. The shutter rewinds.

loop_reveals.2: Look at me. We already know Interval Timer Setting does not fit. This time, watch Shadow Direction before anyone knows we are suspicious.
loop_reveals.3: Something is repeating too precisely. We have Interval Timer Setting and Shadow Direction. Now we find the detail nobody expected us to remember.

action_beats.label: SEARCH THE SCENE WITH ASMA
action_beats.title: SCENE SEARCH
action_beats.text: Asma moves with you through the scene, checking what everyone else ignored. You compare positions, timing, and what looks slightly too deliberate.

action_beats.label: FOLLOW THE MOVEMENT YOU REMEMBER
action_beats.title: PURSUIT
action_beats.text: You move before the moment repeats. Asma follows your lead as you cut across the route you remember from the previous loop.

action_beats.label: TAKE COVER & HOLD POSITION
action_beats.title: TAKE COVER
action_beats.text: The situation turns dangerous. You and Asma take cover, wait for the opening, and move only when the evidence says the risk is worth it.

twist_hint: The obvious explanation for Case 08 is incomplete; one detail only makes sense after the loop repeats.
